title: Monoidal descent and pasting on tensor representatives
statement: Let Q:A→D be lax monoidal with invertible unit and tensorator on pairs whose second argument belongs to a property W. Suppose every object of D is isomorphic to Q(a) for some W(a). For lax monoidal F,G:D→E and τ:F⇒G, monoidality of Q-whiskered τ implies monoidality of τ. In addition, pasting monoidal factorization isomorphisms and a monoidal ordinary unit or compositor gives a monoidal Q-whiskered unit or compositor whenever their component factorization equations hold.

proof.text: Cancel the image of εQ in the unit equation and use naturality. For tensors on models cancel the image of μQ; the whiskered monoidality equation becomes the desired tensor square.

source.place: Tags 04VG and 04VK; naturality, cancellation, and the monoidal natural-transformation equations

proof.text: For arbitrary arguments choose representative isomorphisms and precompose the tensor square with the invertible tensor of their F-images. Naturality transports the model square to the desired square.

proof.text: For identity or composition comparisons, express the Q-whiskered transformation as the pasting of the given factorizations, whiskerings, associators and unitors. Verify this expression componentwise by cancellation. Mathlib monoidality instances for composition and whiskering prove the result.

theorem monoidal_of_tensor_models {A D E : Type*}
    [Category* A] [Category* D] [Category* E]
    [MonoidalCategory A] [MonoidalCategory D] [MonoidalCategory E]
    (Q : A ⥤ D) [Q.LaxMonoidal] (W : A → Prop)
    [IsIso (ε Q)] (hμ : ∀ a b, W b → IsIso (μ Q a b))
    (hmodels : ∀ X : D, ∃ a, W a ∧ Nonempty (Q.obj a ≅ X))
    {F G : D ⥤ E} [F.LaxMonoidal] [G.LaxMonoidal] (τ : F ⟶ G)
    [NatTrans.IsMonoidal (Functor.whiskerLeft Q τ)] : NatTrans.IsMonoidal τ
